CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GenerateUrlByTypeName] ( @Type varchar(50), @TypeID int, @ObjectID int = 0 ) RETURNS varchar(500) AS BEGIN DECLARE @Url varchar(500) = ''
SET @Url = CASE @Type WHEN 'Lookup' THEN 'admin/lookups/' + CAST(@TypeID as varchar) + '/' + CAST(@ObjectID as varchar) WHEN 'LookupType' THEN 'admin/lookups/' + CAST(@TypeID as varchar) WHEN 'ShoppingCartType' THEN 'cart/' + CAST(@ObjectID as varchar) END
RETURN @Url END
